exact.✔ 正確！M-P 等權固定，感知機可調有偏見。: ✔ Correct! M-P weights are equal and fixed; the perceptron's are tunable and biased.
exact.✔ 正確！線性分類器一條直線切不開對角四角。: ✔ Correct! A linear classifier's single straight line can't separate the diagonal corners.
exact.✔ 正確！感知機錯才調（離散），ADALINE 一直用 LMS 梯度。: ✔ Correct! The perceptron adjusts only when wrong (discrete); ADALINE keeps using the LMS gradient.
exact.✔ 正確！0.4 < 0.5 故輸出 0 錯。: ✔ Correct! 0.4 < 0.5, so it outputs 0, which is wrong.
exact.✗ 再想想：誰的權重可調？: ✗ Think again: whose weights are tunable?
exact.✗ 提示：幾何上直線能否切開 XOR？: ✗ Hint: geometrically, can a straight line split XOR?
exact.✗ 提示：離散更新 vs 梯度下降。: ✗ Hint: discrete updates vs gradient descent.
exact.✗ 提示：總分與門檻比較。: ✗ Hint: compare the total score with the threshold.

d2a72ed7112d.zh:
Perceptron 的限制
一條直線，兩場悲劇
d2a72ed7112d.en:
The Limits of the Perceptron
One Line, Two Tragedies

70dfc424dcf5.zh: XOR 切不開，邊界又可能學歪 XOR breaks linearity; unstable boundaries hurt generalization.
70dfc424dcf5.en: XOR can’t be split, and the boundary may also be learned crooked

afc490816a6e.zh: ▾ SCROLL TO EXPLORE · 長頁自學模式
afc490816a6e.en: ▾ SCROLL TO EXPLORE · Long-Page Self-Study Mode

9c6beffd7028.zh:
為何 1958 年的「電子胚胎」
會在 1969 年被一條直線凍結？Why did the 1958 “electronic embryo” freeze on a straight line in 1969?
9c6beffd7028.en:
Why was the 1958 “electronic embryo”
frozen by a single straight line in 1969?

b1b80d4f204e.zh: 答案不在程式碼，在幾何：直線能切 AND，卻切不開 XOR。Not code but geometry: a line cuts AND, not XOR.
b1b80d4f204e.en: The answer isn’t in the code, it’s in the geometry: a straight line can cut AND, but it cannot cut XOR.

df214ff3810a.zh: 一句話史：數學神經 → 自己變聰明 → 教會一群神經 One-Liner History
df214ff3810a.en: One-Line History: Mathematical Neuron → Getting Smarter on Its Own → Teaching a Group of Neurons

0464b17fcdfd.zh: 先用數學做神經（M-P），再想讓它自己變強（Hebb），終於教會一顆神經自己調權重（Perceptron/ADALINE），卻卡在「教會一群」。First math neuron, then self-strengthening, then self-tuning — stuck at teaching a group.
0464b17fcdfd.en: First we built a neuron out of math (M-P), then we wanted it to get stronger on its own (Hebb), and finally we taught a single neuron to adjust its own weights (Perceptron/ADALINE), only to get stuck on “teaching a group.”

a14661cdff0f.zh: 加法＋門檻，權重固定相等，輸出 0/1；足夠多即可做 AND/OR/NOT。Sum + threshold, fixed equal weights, 0/1.
a14661cdff0f.en: Addition + a threshold, fixed equal weights, 0/1 output; with enough of them you can build AND/OR/NOT.

b54cbcf37ed2.zh: Hebb 學習 Fire Together, Wire Together
b54cbcf37ed2.en: Hebbian Learning Fire Together, Wire Together

360be30f9331.zh: 一起放電→連結變強；獎勵為 1 的輸入，雛形學習。Co-fire → strengthen.
360be30f9331.en: Fire together → the connection gets stronger; reward the inputs that are 1, an embryonic form of learning.

dff6959658e0.zh: 權重可調：Perceptron 錯了才調，ADALINE 以梯度下降追求誤差最小。Tunable weights; error-driven vs gradient.
dff6959658e0.en: Tunable weights: the perceptron adjusts only when it’s wrong, while ADALINE uses gradient descent to chase the minimum error.

2f44b3599ef3.zh: 單層線性不可解 XOR；多層在理論上可解卻沒有高效訓練程式，直到 Backprop。Linear cannot do XOR; multi-layer lacked algorithm.
2f44b3599ef3.en: A single linear layer cannot solve XOR; multiple layers could in theory, but there was no efficient training procedure until backpropagation.

b28541aa9c27.zh: 直覺 · 法拉利與輪子
b28541aa9c27.en: Intuition · The Ferrari and the Wheel

2bfd5c3d29b2.zh: 會開法拉利前先懂輪子：M-P 是輪子，Hebb 是「獎勵好輪子」的想法，Perceptron 是會自己換輪子的車。Before Ferrari, understand wheel: M-P is wheel, Hebb is “reward good wheels”, Perceptron swaps wheels itself.
2bfd5c3d29b2.en: Before you can drive a Ferrari, understand the wheel: M-P is the wheel, Hebb is the idea of “rewarding good wheels,” and the perceptron is a car that swaps its own wheels.

74ec776abc4d.zh: S2 · 第一根神經 · FIRST NEURON

969b03465ef2.zh: 1 · M-P 模型（1943）：史上第一根數學神經 M-P Model — Mathematical Neuron
969b03465ef2.en: 1 · The M-P Model (1943): History’s First Mathematical Neuron

096cabf98dc3.zh: 真空管如房間大的年代，McCulloch（神經生理）與 Pitts（邏輯）把神經簡化為「有原則的傳聲筒」：等權相加→門檻比較→0/1。Vacuum-tube era: sum equally → threshold → 0/1.
096cabf98dc3.en: In an era when vacuum-tube computers were the size of a room, McCulloch (neurophysiology) and Pitts (logic) simplified the neuron into a “principled megaphone”: add with equal weights → compare with a threshold → 0/1.

7012c9b74669.zh: M-P 數學神經：等權相加，與門檻比較，輸出 0/1 · Hebb 口訣：Cells that fire together, wire together.
7012c9b74669.en: M-P mathematical neuron: add with equal weights, compare with a threshold, output 0/1 · Hebb’s motto: Cells that fire together, wire together.

4b3461362438.zh: 為何重要 · Why It Matters

76614819c6aa.zh: 證明足夠多這類單元可實現 AND / OR / NOT → 具通用邏輯能力，為網路奠基。Enough units → universal logic (AND/OR/NOT).
76614819c6aa.en: It proved that enough of these units can implement AND / OR / NOT → universal logical capability, laying the foundation for networks.

332a655b4525.zh: 所有輸入等重，一視同仁；超過門檻就大叫 1，否則 0——最純的二元決策。Equal weights; fire if sum > threshold.
332a655b4525.en: All inputs weigh the same and are treated equally; if the total exceeds the threshold it shouts 1, otherwise 0—the purest binary decision.

bd7afaa0e771.zh: 權重固定、需手設門檻，不會學習；等待 Hebb 與 Rosenblatt 解放。Fixed weights, no learning.
bd7afaa0e771.en: Fixed weights and a hand-set threshold, so it cannot learn; it waits for Hebb and Rosenblatt to set it free.

736858a98dee.zh: 示意：$n$ 個 0/1 輸入等權相加，與閾值 $\theta$ 比較；多單元互連可表任意邏輯。Equal-weight sum vs threshold; networked → any logic.
736858a98dee.en: Sketch: $n$ binary (0/1) inputs are added with equal weights and compared with the threshold $\theta$; interconnecting many units can express any logic.

73a2446452e9.zh: S2 · 棍棒與糖果 · LEARNING IDEA
73a2446452e9.en: S2 · STICK AND CANDY · LEARNING IDEA

57fe892fe0cf.zh: 2 · Hebb 學習（1949）：一起放電，一起變強 Hebbian Learning
57fe892fe0cf.en: 2 · Hebbian Learning (1949): Fire Together, Wire Together

9d222dbeae73.zh: Donald Hebb 一句話開啟學習時代：常一起出現的輸入與答案，其連結變強；不再手調。Co-occurrence → stronger wire; no hand-tuning.
9d222dbeae73.en: Donald Hebb opened the era of learning with one sentence: when an input and an answer often occur together, their connection gets stronger; no more hand-tuning.

460201d9476c.zh: Δw ∝ x · y  （共放電則加強）
460201d9476c.en: Δw ∝ x · y  (strengthen when firing together)

ad99dd80ba2a.zh: 為 1 的輸入與正確答案一起→權重調大
ad99dd80ba2a.en: Input is 1 together with the correct answer → increase the weight

cd1330a20f80.zh: Hebb 雛形：獎勵常與正解共現的輸入，連結變強 · Reward co-firing.
cd1330a20f80.en: Hebb’s prototype: reward inputs that often co-occur with the correct answer, and their connection gets stronger.

b57fa8c5588c.zh: 「一起放電，一起變強」——從手調到自學的哲學轉折。From hand-tuned to self-tuning philosophy.
b57fa8c5588c.en: “Fire together, wire together”—the philosophical turn from hand-tuning to self-learning.

812cace8bb89.zh: 常與正解一起的輸入吃糖（$w$ 調大），否則棍棒；Perceptron 與 ADALINE 皆受此啟發。Co-fire → candy (up-weight).
812cace8bb89.en: Inputs that often show up with the correct answer get candy ($w$ goes up), otherwise the stick; both the perceptron and ADALINE were inspired by this.

b1eb8c2fb3a0.zh: Hebb 給方向，未給可收斂的數學規則；Rosenblatt 與 Widrow 才把它變成可執行程式。Idea, not yet algorithm.
b1eb8c2fb3a0.en: Hebb gave a direction, but not a mathematical rule that converges; it took Rosenblatt and Widrow to turn it into an executable procedure.

517f77198aac.zh: 公式 · Hebb 更新雛形

bd43da5e4a57.zh: 共放電（$x_j$ 與 $y$ 同為 1）則加強；為後續有監督調整埋下伏筆。Co-fire → strengthen; precursor to supervised correction.
bd43da5e4a57.en: Firing together ($x_j$ and $y$ both 1) strengthens the connection; this lays the groundwork for later supervised adjustment.

0d93f73f60d5.zh: 3 · Perceptron（1958）：終於有偏見、會自己學 Perceptron — Biased & Self-Tuning
0d93f73f60d5.en: 3 · The Perceptron (1958): Finally Biased, and Learning on Its Own

ca0689781020.zh: 與 M-P 最大不同：每輸入有權重 $w_j$ 表示重要性；錯了才調，調錯的。Per-input weight $w_j$ = importance; correct only when wrong.
ca0689781020.en: The biggest difference from M-P: each input has a weight $w_j$ that expresses its importance; it adjusts only when it’s wrong, and adjusts what was wrong.

e4103c8d28e1.zh: 對了不調，錯了才調（有監督）
e4103c8d28e1.en: No change if right, adjust only if wrong (supervised)

4f26b4a39d37.zh: Rosenblatt：電子胚胎將能看說寫 · embryo will see/speak/write
4f26b4a39d37.en: Rosenblatt: the electronic embryo will see, speak, and write

66659977f286.zh: 權重可調、有偏見；有監督錯了才調 · Tunable biased; supervised correction on error.
66659977f286.en: Tunable weights with biases; supervised, adjusting only when wrong.

0a6c06978c7f.zh: $w_j$ 代表重要性：紅色重要則 $w_1$ 大，圓形次要則 $w_2$ 小——模型終於有主見。$w_j$ = importance; model gains opinion.
0a6c06978c7f.en: $w_j$ represents importance: if red matters, $w_1$ is large; if roundness is secondary, $w_2$ is small—the model finally has opinions of its own.

f5b46cff032e.zh: 能自學認數字，記者驚呼將能走說看寫有意識——可惜被一條直線打臉。Self-learn digits → hype → hit by a line.
f5b46cff032e.en: It could teach itself to recognize digits, and reporters gasped that it would walk, talk, see, write, and be conscious—too bad it got slapped down by a straight line.

a825609728e5.zh: $w_j \leftarrow w_j + \eta x_j (y-\hat y)$，$b \leftarrow b - \eta(y-\hat y)$；該 1 猜 0 則獎為 1 的輸入。Reward co-firing on error.
a825609728e5.en: $w_j \leftarrow w_j + \eta x_j (y-\hat y)$, $b \leftarrow b - \eta(y-\hat y)$; if it should say 1 but guesses 0, reward the inputs that are 1.

9e3eaa63594e.zh: 公式 · 感知機決策與學習

5952ea262d12.zh: 有監督、離散更新（非梯度），幾何上為移動直線。Supervised, discrete correction; moves the line.
5952ea262d12.en: Supervised, discrete updates (not gradient-based); geometrically, it moves a straight line.

a42192cb6701.zh: 感知機計算：遙認紅蘋果 Perceptron in Action — Red Apple?
a42192cb6701.en: Perceptron Calculation: Spotting a Red Apple from Afar

62fe450f8ab7.zh: 兩特徵 $x_1$紅/$x_2$圓、AND 邏輯（紅 AND 圓才 1）、$\eta=0.1$、初始 $w=(0.1,0.3), b=0.5$。Two features, AND logic, $\eta=0.1$, init $w=(0.1,0.3), b=0.5$.
62fe450f8ab7.en: Two features, $x_1$ red / $x_2$ round, AND logic (1 only if red AND round), $\eta=0.1$, initial $w=(0.1,0.3), b=0.5$.

ece94bea6760.en: Red apple AND, step by step

fac338ede2a6.zh: Rosenblatt 更新（該 1 猜 0→獎為 1 的輸入）
fac338ede2a6.en: Rosenblatt update (should be 1, guessed 0 → reward inputs that are 1)

49b605e5e4ec.zh: 結果：更喜歡紅色，更易啟動
49b605e5e4ec.en: Result: likes red more, fires more easily

8b15f6fe4520.zh: 該 1 猜 0→給為 1 的輸入加糖，門檻降低 · Reward co-firing, lower threshold.
8b15f6fe4520.en: Should be 1 but guessed 0 → give candy to the inputs that are 1, and lower the threshold.

ef594ba56799.zh: 猜太小（該 1 猜 0）→讓為 1 的 $x_j$ 加分，$b$ 降門檻。下次同樣蘋果更容易說 1。Under-predict → boost active $x_j$, lower $b$.
ef594ba56799.en: Guessed too low (should be 1, guessed 0) → add points to the $x_j$ that are 1, and lower the threshold via $b$. Next time the same apple is more likely to get a 1.

51ea917e9ed4.zh: 一次就讓 $w_1$ 0.1→0.2，模型學會偏愛紅色——經驗累積為偏見。One step: $w_1$ 0.1→0.2 — experience becomes bias.
51ea917e9ed4.en: A single step takes $w_1$ from 0.1→0.2, and the model learns to favor red—experience accumulates into bias.

e31355527219.en: But It Must Face the Line Eventually

092154c9c234.zh: 更新本質是移動切割直線；能切 AND，卻永不能切 XOR。Update moves the line — cuts AND, never XOR.
092154c9c234.en: An update is essentially moving the cutting line; it can cut AND, but it can never cut XOR.

5aa72847135b.zh: 本例：$y-\hat y=1$，$x=(1,1)$，$\eta=0.1$ → $\Delta w=(0.1,0.1)$, $\Delta b=-0.1$。Error 1, $x=(1,1)$ → $\Delta w=(0.1,0.1)$.
5aa72847135b.en: In this example: $y-\hat y=1$, $x=(1,1)$, $\eta=0.1$ → $\Delta w=(0.1,0.1)$, $\Delta b=-0.1$.

66a95495fa17.zh: 互動：拉動 $\eta$ 看更新幅度 · Drag $\eta$ to see step size
66a95495fa17.en: Interactive: drag $\eta$ to see the update size

032c508b2ca7.zh: 冰河期：一條直線凍結浪潮 Winter — A Line Freezes the Wave
032c508b2ca7.en: The Winter: A Single Line Freezes the Wave

f404dd36d891.zh: 感知機是線性分類器：一刀切。AND 可切，XOR 不可切。Minsky & Papert 1969 以嚴謹證明澆熄樂觀。Linear classifier: one cut. AND yes, XOR no. 1969 proof killed hype.
f404dd36d891.en: The perceptron is a linear classifier: one cut. AND can be cut; XOR cannot. In 1969, Minsky & Papert doused the optimism with a rigorous proof.

8e1e2b98ad4b.zh: matplotlib 精準：線性可分 vs 非線性 · AND vs XOR geometry
8e1e2b98ad4b.en: matplotlib, precise: linearly separable vs non-linear · AND vs XOR geometry

8b914900d8b8.zh: 左 AND：$x_1+x_2=1.5$ 一刀切開；右 XOR：任何直線均失敗 · Left: line cuts AND; right: no line cuts XOR.
8b914900d8b8.en: Left, AND: the line $x_1+x_2=1.5$ cuts it in one stroke; right, XOR: every straight line fails.

4a22c1f7c4bb.zh: 為何 XOR 殺死單層
4a22c1f7c4bb.en: Why XOR Killed the Single Layer

3502d9fbb3e9.zh: 四角點對角同類：$(0,0)/(1,1)$ 一類，$(0,1)/(1,0)$ 另一類——沒直線可分。Corners diagonal same class — no line.
3502d9fbb3e9.en: Diagonal corners share a class: $(0,0)/(1,1)$ are one class, $(0,1)/(1,0)$ are the other—no straight line can separate them.

f1570da6de4c.zh: 多層理論可解，卻無法教
f1570da6de4c.en: Multiple Layers Could Solve It in Theory, but Couldn’t Be Taught

e9995141998a.zh: Rosenblatt 書《Principles of Neurodynamics》嘗試鬆散串聯，但差正確時不知調哪層——直到 Backprop。Multi-layer could in theory, but no training rule until Backprop.
e9995141998a.en: Rosenblatt’s book “Principles of Neurodynamics” tried loosely chaining units together, but when the output was off, no one knew which layer to adjust—until backpropagation.

078e4af4b908.zh: 《Perceptrons》一書凍結十年；需要新數學才能教會一群神經。Book froze a decade; needed new math to teach a crowd.
078e4af4b908.en: The book “Perceptrons” froze the field for a decade; new math was needed to teach a group of neurons.

ff90eff69e70.zh: S2 · 更穩的學 · STABLE LEARNING

3290e1688e29.zh: 5 · ADALINE / MADALINE（1960）：梯度下降學更穩 ADALINE — Gradient Descent Learns Steadier
3290e1688e29.en: 5 · ADALINE / MADALINE (1960): Gradient Descent Learns More Steadily

7cfd6b3108bc.zh: 感知機「對不調錯才調」，ADALINE「追求完美」——看總分與正確的均方誤差，用梯度下降持續微調。Perceptron tunes on error; ADALINE chases LMS via gradient descent, always tuning.
7cfd6b3108bc.en: The perceptron “leaves it alone when right, adjusts only when wrong”; ADALINE “strives for perfection”—it looks at the mean squared error between the total score and the correct answer, and keeps fine-tuning with gradient descent.

1937e12293f5.zh: matplotlib 精準：左 MSE 地形 + 梯度路徑至 w* · 右離散調整 vs 持續 LMS · Precise terrain & discrete vs continuous.
1937e12293f5.en: matplotlib, precise: left, MSE landscape + gradient path to w* · right, discrete adjustments vs continuous LMS

b3fc1e205783.zh: 不看 0/1、看總分誤差。沿負梯度走，追求均方誤差最小。Not 0/1 but score error; follow negative gradient.
b3fc1e205783.en: It doesn’t look at the 0/1 output, it looks at the error in the total score. It walks along the negative gradient, seeking the minimum mean squared error.

9da0c7db6475.zh: 數學更穩、泛化更好，但本質仍線性——也被冰河凍住。More robust, better generalization, still linear.
9da0c7db6475.en: Mathematically steadier, with better generalization, but still linear at heart—so it too was frozen by the winter.

0e818d74a73c.zh: 疊 Many ADALINEs，MR III 換 Sigmoid 可導函式才能算梯度教多層，卻未形成系統理論直到 Backprop。MR III used sigmoid to allow gradients for multi-layer.
0e818d74a73c.en: Stack many ADALINEs; only when MR III switched to the differentiable sigmoid function could gradients be computed to teach multiple layers, but no systematic theory formed until backpropagation.

d7e741982048.zh: $\hat s=\mathbf{w}^\top\mathbf{x}$ 為總分（未閾值），每步沿負梯度下降。$\hat s$ is pre-threshold score; step along negative gradient.
d7e741982048.en: $\hat s=\mathbf{w}^\top\mathbf{x}$ is the total score (before thresholding); each step descends along the negative gradient.

a542aee1578b.zh: 三波神經網路簡表 Three Generations
a542aee1578b.en: The Three Waves of Neural Networks at a Glance

be385e2ee51d.zh: 無法解 XOR；啟動從例子中學習
be385e2ee51d.en: Cannot solve XOR; kicked off learning from examples

b6999548af2e.zh: 利用放電時間差，未來方向
b6999548af2e.en: Uses spike-timing differences; a future direction

af5c143bc540.zh: 先做出神經（M-P）→想讓它自強（Hebb）→教會一顆自學（Perceptron/ADALINE）→卡在教會一群（直到 Backprop）。Neuron → self-strengthen → one learns → group stuck until Backprop.
af5c143bc540.en: First build a neuron (M-P) → want it to strengthen itself (Hebb) → teach one neuron to learn on its own (Perceptron/ADALINE) → stuck on teaching a group (until backpropagation).

033a6c44db5b.zh: 1980 年代，科學家終於找到教一群神經的神奇訓練程式——反向傳播。1980s: finally the algorithm to teach a crowd — Backprop.
033a6c44db5b.en: In the 1980s, scientists finally found the magic training procedure for teaching a group of neurons: backpropagation.

5c6b084f63e4.zh: 深入：邏輯閘、訓練程式與冰河的連動 Deeper — Logic, Algorithm & Winter
5c6b084f63e4.en: Going Deeper: How Logic Gates, the Training Procedure, and the Winter Connect

5d611b05e770.zh: ADALINE 1960 梯度下降更穩、MADALINE 直到 Sigmoid 才可導 → Backprop 才終結冰河
5d611b05e770.en: ADALINE 1960: gradient descent is steadier; MADALINE not differentiable until sigmoid → only backprop ended the winter

9d3369db283c.zh: 四站時光機：數學神經→自強→自學→凍結（線性終數） · Four stops: neuron → strengthen → learn → freeze.
9d3369db283c.en: A four-stop time machine: mathematical neuron → self-strengthening → self-learning → frozen (the linear limit).

0dc9cfaa83ee.zh: M-P 給了邏輯通用性，Hebb 給了學習哲學，Perceptron 把哲學變成可執行程式，ADALINE 用梯度更穩——但線性終數讓重點在「教會一群」。M-P gave logic, Hebb gave philosophy, Perceptron made algorithm, ADALINE stabilized — but linear caps at teaching a crowd.
0dc9cfaa83ee.en: M-P gave logical universality, Hebb gave the philosophy of learning, the perceptron turned the philosophy into an executable procedure, and ADALINE made it steadier with gradients—but the linear limit put the focus on “teaching a group.”

8fe65dcdd160.zh: 學會考古題，不代表懂規則 Training Accuracy Is Not Generalization
8fe65dcdd160.en: Acing the Past Exams Doesn’t Mean You Understand the Rules

3a3715a80a7d.zh: 即使資料線性可分，感知機也可能找到許多條都能 100% 分開訓練集的邊界；隨機初始權重與資料順序，會影響最後停在哪一條。Many boundaries can fit the training set; initialization and order can change the final one.
3a3715a80a7d.en: Even when the data are linearly separable, the perceptron may find many boundaries that all separate the training set 100%; the random initial weights and the order of the data affect which one it finally stops at.

59f022299ef4.zh: 兩條線都能透過訓練集
59f022299ef4.en: Both lines pass the training set

28def32a2823.zh: 邊界 B · 留出間隔

ec56b6cfe79c.zh: 訓練集相同、測試點不同結果；留出較寬安全區通常更穩 · Same training fit, different test behavior.
ec56b6cfe79c.en: Same training set, different results on the test point; leaving a wider safety zone is usually more robust.

76cba9fe5871.zh: 感知機只要找到一條可行邊界就停止，不會主動偏好「離兩類都遠」的最大間隔。It accepts any separating boundary, not the widest margin.
76cba9fe5871.en: The perceptron stops as soon as it finds any feasible boundary; it does not actively prefer the maximum-margin one that is “far from both classes.”

25ac92fb7691.zh: 像把分隔線貼著其中一排同學畫：考古題全答對，但新同學一靠近邊界就容易被分錯。A boundary hugging one class is fragile on new examples.
25ac92fb7691.en: It’s like drawing the dividing line right up against one row of classmates: you ace every past exam question, but as soon as a new classmate comes near the boundary, they easily get misclassified.

69d1ad3304b4.zh: 真正要問的不是「訓練集有幾分」，而是「沒看過的資料還能不能判對」。Ask about unseen data, not training score alone.
69d1ad3304b4.en: The real question isn’t “what’s the score on the training set,” but “can it still judge unseen data correctly.”

8dcbc57f2b58.zh: 核心判準 · The real criterion

c9ccc280bcba.zh: 感知機的線性可分保證只保證「能找到邊界」；它不保證找到對新資料最穩健的邊界。Separability guarantees a boundary, not the most robust boundary.
c9ccc280bcba.en: The perceptron’s linear-separability guarantee only guarantees that “a boundary can be found”; it does not guarantee finding the boundary that is most robust on new data.

013019224e7f.zh: 思考測驗：你懂線性終數嗎？ Quiz — Do You Get Linear Limit?
013019224e7f.en: Quiz: Do You Get the Linear Limit?

79a8c48ae390.zh: Q1. M-P 模型與感知機的最大差異是？Key difference M-P vs Perceptron?
79a8c48ae390.en: Q1. What is the biggest difference between the M-P model and the perceptron?

b099c518abbe.zh: M-P 會自學，感知機不會M-P learns
b099c518abbe.en: M-P learns on its own; the perceptron does not

0b56a62b1b4e.zh: M-P 權重固定等重；感知機權重可調且有偏見Fixed equal vs tunable biased
0b56a62b1b4e.en: M-P weights are fixed and equal; perceptron weights are tunable and biased

19ceecf79539.zh: M-P 是多層，感知機是單層M-P multi-layer
19ceecf79539.en: M-P is multilayer; the perceptron is single-layer

a0bde25ddde7.zh: M-P 用梯度下降M-P uses gradient

3456ca7828b7.zh: Q2. 為何單層感知機無法解 XOR？Why single-layer cannot solve XOR?
3456ca7828b7.en: Q2. Why can’t a single-layer perceptron solve XOR?

fc560a007247.zh: 因為是線性分類器，一條直線切不開對角同類四角Linear: no line cuts diagonal
fc560a007247.en: Because it is a linear classifier, and one straight line can’t separate four corners where diagonal corners share a class

f19e5254314b.zh: 因為沒有 SigmoidNo sigmoid

036e0d6fb7a0.zh: 因為 Hebb 口訣錯誤Hebb wrong

a4c1d213d184.zh: 因為學習率太小Learning rate small
a4c1d213d184.en: Because the learning rate is too small

2b217e02b41c.zh: Q3. Perceptron 與 ADALINE 學習方式差異？Perceptron vs ADALINE learning?
2b217e02b41c.en: Q3. How do the perceptron and ADALINE differ in the way they learn?

f7a0c09198b4.zh: 都是梯度下降Both gradient

156f90e175b3.zh: Perceptron 用梯度，ADALINE 錯才調Swapped
156f90e175b3.en: The perceptron uses gradients; ADALINE adjusts only when wrong

60b523b94890.zh: Perceptron 錯才調；ADALINE 看總分誤差用梯度一直微調Error-only vs always LMS
60b523b94890.en: The perceptron adjusts only when wrong; ADALINE looks at the error in the total score and keeps fine-tuning with gradients

e5f35db2d32e.zh: ADALINE 不能疊 SigmoidADALINE no sigmoid
e5f35db2d32e.en: ADALINE cannot be stacked with a sigmoid

69af0456835c.zh: Q4. 感知機紅蘋果例：$w=(0.1,0.3), b=0.5$，$x=(1,1)$ 為何猜錯？Why wrong with (1,1)?
69af0456835c.en: Q4. In the perceptron red-apple example, $w=(0.1,0.3), b=0.5$: why does it guess wrong for $x=(1,1)$?

bf6d07035a44.zh: 因為是 XORBecause XOR

72c8d89ba178.zh: 總分 $0.4 < 0.5$門檻，故輸出 0 而正確 1Score 0.4 < 0.5
72c8d89ba178.en: The total score $0.4 < 0.5$, the threshold, so it outputs 0 while the correct answer is 1

7d3158a08b69.zh: 因為 $\eta$太大Eta too large

af39ef9dffa1.zh: 因為沒有歸一化No normalization

adfee82fae4f.en: Draw the four points on graph paper, try any straight line, and verify that XOR can’t be cut.

a8ddbb457111.zh: 同資料分別用離散更新與梯度下降，比較收斂穩定度。Compare discrete vs gradient convergence.
a8ddbb457111.en: On the same data, use discrete updates and gradient descent separately, and compare how stably they converge.

c5d74261ec16.en: Think about it: if the output is wrong, should you adjust layer 1 or layer 2? Revealed in the next section.
